files.elev.i16.gz: metres, int16 LE; Copernicus DSM averaged to 250 m; includes trees and buildings
files.water.u8.gz: 0 land, 1 ocean, 2 lake, 3 river; Copernicus water body mask, majority per cell; ocean also where no DEM tile exists
files.tree.u8.gz: percent tree cover, ESA WorldCover 2021 class 10 (modern)
files.built.u8.gz: percent built-up, WorldCover class 50 (modern; reference only, 1944 towns come from the 1936 census)
